name: Staff of Power

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

magic.attunement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

last.text: loses every property but its +2 bonus

powers.name: Power Strike
powers.text: Arm it: your next hit with the staff spends 1 charge for an extra 1d6 Force damage.

powers.name: Retributive Strike

summary: +2 quarterstaff, +2 AC, saves and spell attacks; 20 charges of powerful spells; Power Strike; Retributive Strike.
text: A magic Quarterstaff with +2 to attack and damage rolls. While you hold it, you also get +2 to saving throws, spell attack rolls and Armor Class. It holds 20 charges and recovers 2d8 + 4 of them at dawn. After the last charge is spent, roll 1d20: a 1 strips the staff of everything except its +2 to attack and damage rolls, while a 20 restores 1d8 + 2 charges to it. Power Strike: after a melee hit with the staff, spend 1 charge to add 1d6 Force damage. Spells: spend charges to cast these, using your own spell attack bonus and save DC: Globe of Invulnerability (6 charges); Cone of Cold, Hold Monster, Wall of Force, or Fireball or Lightning Bolt at level 5 (5 charges each); Levitate (2 charges); Magic Missile or Ray of Enfeeblement (1 charge). Retributive Strike: as a Magic action, snap the staff across your knee or on a hard surface. It is destroyed, and its released magic explodes through a 30-foot Emanation around the staff. There is a 50 percent chance you are instantly whisked away to some random plane of existence, escaping the blast; otherwise the explosion deals you 16 Force damage per charge left in the staff. All other creatures caught in it must attempt a Dexterity saving throw (DC 17), taking Force damage on a failure based on distance from the staff: within 10 feet, 8 times the charges; 11 to 20 feet, 6 times; 21 to 30 feet, 4 times. A success halves the damage.
